title: Rational homology and Quillen's conjecture
summary: We prove Quillen's conjecture for all finite groups and all primes. More precisely, if a finite group G has trivial largest normal p -subgroup $`O_p(G)`$, then the poset of nontrivial elementary abelian p -subgroups of G has nonzero augmented reduced rational homology. This establishes the stronger rational-homology form of the conjecture.

review.reason: Proves Quillen's conjecture in rational homology for finite groups and all primes.
